## 02 / Learn by building

First-year B.Tech Computer Science student at NCERC Pambady, Kerala. Got into
coding at 12 and never stopped — IoT, web, and backend, mostly figured out as I
go.

Most of my projects started because I wanted to understand how something works. I
build fast with AI tools — shipping things I couldn't have built alone yet, then
digging in to understand why they work. Some projects are finished, some are still
being figured out.

Right now I'm looking for an internship where I can actually contribute and learn
from people who've been doing this longer than me.

Numbers: started coding at 12 · 4 projects shipped · curiosity, unbounded.

## 03 / Selected work

### ExamForge — edtech
Online exam and quiz platform. Teachers create exams, students take them, results
come out automatically — built to replace a real workflow.
Repository: https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/ExamForge

### Gas Guard — IoT
Arduino with gas sensors that triggers an alert when it detects a leak. A
practical safety tool, not a demo.
Repository: https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/GAS-GUARD

### NMHSS Thirunavaya — live in production
The official website for my school. Actually live and actually being used — my
first real users.
Repository: https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/nmhss-project

### Orvaya — client work
Website built for a real business. Professional look, works properly on every
screen size.
Repository: https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/Orvaya
